mission_03: Great work! You have successfully implemented robust scaling and compared it with min-max scaling. You learned how the median and IQR provide outlier-resistant centering and scaling. Notice how the extreme income value (500000) gets a min-max score near 1.0, compressing all other values, while robust scaling gives it a moderate score that does not distort the rest of the data. Use robust scaling whenever your data contains outliers that you do not want to remove. It is particularly useful for financial data, sensor readings, and any dataset with heavy-tailed distributions.
